title: Gradients for Interventions and Activation Values for Detection: Targeted Feature Learning in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.32355v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model-internal features can be studied through both their ability to identify a specified concept and their causal effect when manipulated, e.g., through steering or weight editing. A prominent approach to feature learning is Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), which learn broad feature dictionaries whose relation to particular concepts is typically identified post hoc. However, many interpretability questions are instead hypothesis-driven and concern a concept specified in advance. We study this setting as targeted feature learning, where a single feature is constructed for such a predefined concept. We present a controlled comparison across three model signals (activation values, activation gradients, and parameter gradients) and two estimators (contrastive mean and a learned one-dimensional encoder-decoder), yielding six targeted methods, with CAA and GRADIEND as existing instances and four new methods covering the remaining combinations.

translated_title: 用于干预的梯度与用于检测的激活值：语言模型中的定向特征学习
translated_abstract: 模型内部特征可以通过两种方式进行研究：一是识别特定概念的能力，二是被操纵时（例如通过引导或权重编辑）产生的因果效应。特征学习的一种主流方法是稀疏自编码器（SAE），它学习广泛的特征字典，其与特定概念的关系通常是事后确定的。然而，许多可解释性问题恰恰相反，是假设驱动的，涉及预先指定的概念。我们将这一设定称为定向特征学习，即为这样一个预定义概念构建单一特征。我们提出了一个受控比较，涵盖三种模型信号（激活值、激活梯度和参数梯度）和两种估计器（对比均值和可学习的一维编码器-解码器），由此产生六种定向方法，其中CAA和GRADIEND是已有方法，另外四种新方法覆盖了其余的组合。
tldr: 该论文提出“定向特征学习”框架，为预定义概念构建单一特征，并系统比较了三种模型信号（激活值、激活梯度、参数梯度）与两种估计器组合而成的六种方法，其中CAA和GRADIEND为已有方法，另外四种为新提出的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes targeted feature learning—constructing a single feature for a predefined concept—and presents a controlled comparison of six methods spanning three model signals (activation values, activation gradients, parameter gradients) and two estimators (contrastive mean and a learned one-dimensional encoder-decoder), with CAA and GRADIEND as existing instances and four novel methods covering the remaining combinations.
